objective: Build an actual native macOS application that progressively reconstructs the full Cubase Pro workflow: project persistence, musical and audio editing, MIDI, mixing and routing, plug-in hosting, automation, export and interaction. Ground each claimed Cubase behavior in an auditable chain from exact artifact bytes or primary documentation to independent implementation checks and, when authorized, repeatable reference comparisons. A bounded DSP kernel is one slice of this objective, not its replacement.

phases.action: Acquire the official installer; retain URL, HTTP headers, byte count and SHA-256. Inspect/extract locally without treating installer acquisition as a running reference. Inventory bundle identity and architecture slices.

Use the installed REA release's Apple artifact tools to enumerate bundle anatomy, resources, native boundaries, executable metadata and dependencies. Preserve structured outputs, exact commands, errors and limitations.

Verify one explicitly selected native-analysis provider against a self-authored calibration executable. Record provider version, architecture, analysis options and deadlines. Calibration is synthetic control evidence only.

Choose one discriminating static hypothesis tied to the next full-application workflow or compatibility gap while reference runtime work is deferred. Search focused strings, symbols, resources and references; retain positive and negative results. Avoid whole-binary pseudocode dumps without a concrete question.

For each candidate function retain artifact digest, architecture slice, image base/address or file offset, instructions, callers/callees and tool uncertainty. Distinguish names inferred by the analyst from original symbols.

Derive probes that distinguish plausible explanations. During the static-first phase, use independent byte/instruction review and synthetic transcription checks. Runtime falsification remains pending; later retain exact target inputs, state, actions and repeated outputs.

Implement the actual native application in bounded, reviewable slices. Integrate persistence, UI, editing, scheduling and rendering as well as exact static-derived kernels. Label independently defined choices, documented semantics and traced native instructions separately. Verify the application with analytic/negative controls, source review and real native UI workflows. Shared agent context is not an isolated clean-room implementation. Do not claim target conformance from these checks.

Track implemented application workflows, static mappings, unresolved cases, reference observations and conformance separately across the whole product. Passing tests and a working slice do not establish full Cubase fidelity or an exhaustive feature denominator.

operating_rules: Use CLI capabilities of the pinned package in this project; an MCP registration is optional for CLI work.
Read the pinned REA routing skill and the exact operation reference before using unfamiliar commands.
Keep raw target artifacts local and unmodified; write analysis into separate evidence directories.
Do not silently substitute another edition, build, architecture, engine or operating system after a failed operation.
Do not call an unexecuted command successful; retain partial output and resource/deadline failures.
Do not extrapolate a function reconstruction or passing sample comparison into full Cubase equivalence.

Classify evidence as primary documentation, inert resource/source declarations, native instructions, independent application choices, synthetic/application checks or target runtime observations; do not silently promote one class into another.
Export and validate retained REA evidence before closing sessions. Keep bounded raw-slice context losses, provider errors, source snapshots and digests explicit.

Preserve original reports and failed attempts. Implement or extend real application workflows alongside research; never replace the full application objective with documentation or isolated DSP progress.

current_phase_override.effect: Cubase reference execution is deferred. Continue static research and build, execute and verify the independently authored native application, including bounded static-derived candidates, without claiming measured reference fidelity.

iteration_status.whole_product_status: Very incomplete; no full reconstruction or target conformance established.
implemented_scope: Self-contained projects and media, mono/stereo timeline editing, playback, meters, gain/pan/mute/solo, save/load/undo and stereo float32 mixdown.

Native application jump-only tempo maps, bar-boundary signature maps, bars/beats ruler, bar/beat/quantize and relative snap; seconds or musical track timebase retimes musical starts without stretching audio.
Editable gain/pan read automation with explicit outgoing hold/linear segments evaluated at absolute sample times in playback and export.

Strict DAWproject 1.0 flat audio import/export with seconds clips, embedded mono/stereo media at integral 8–192 kHz, jump tempo/signature maps and explicit gain/pan interpolation; unsupported semantics reject.
Standalone 4/9/16-channel float32/float64 Ambisonic file conversion using the reviewed static-derived C processor and explicit IEEE-float WAV writer.

Bounded CPR profile-v2 import recovers ordered empty audio tracks, a verified shared fixed-tempo clock with native Float32 period and binary64 operation order, and a simple origin meter only when compact and typed records agree. Original bytes and versioned reports remain preserved; frozen v1 reports replay unchanged. Active native clocks must match the source-replayed report on load/save. Wrong interface roles use an explicit 120 BPM application default; unsupported native state never becomes playable content.

Native fixed-clock editing/export requires explicit application-timing conversion; load/save require matching preserved-source report proof. Origin signature recovery is independent of active fixed/map mode.
implementation_limits: Variable native tempo-map selection, boundaries/cache lifecycle and ramp arithmetic remain outside the implemented native clock. General application timing/read curves do not establish native mixing or writer behavior.

DAWproject schema checks and local roundtrips are not Cubase interoperability evidence. Musical anchors, disabled automation, complex routing and plug-ins remain outside the exchange subset; native fixed timing requires explicit conversion.
Ambisonic conversion is a standalone file operation with restricted sample/FP domains, not a live multichannel bus or plug-in insert.
Playback edits rebuild prepared buffers. Recording, MIDI editing, plug-in hosting, mixer/PDC, automation writing, time stretching and complete CPR compatibility remain major gaps.

CPR imports restore empty audio tracks, supported shared fixed-clock arithmetic and branch-invariant origin meter only. Audio-event coordinates and AudioCluster segments are not bound to playable media. Unsupported-map120BPM,48 kHz,unrecovered 4/4 and mixer defaults remain explicit. Frozen v1 interpretation is preserved separately from v2.
iteration_status.gui_validation_status: 12 bounded native Rebase GUI groups passed;three saved packages and converted export independently verified.

next_priorities.question: Which remaining iterator/boundary/cache contracts complete the native map clock, and how do audio-event coordinates and AudioCluster segments resolve playable source intervals?
next_priorities.action: Bind map iterator selection, exact boundaries, quantization/ramp arithmetic and cache initialization before implementing variable native maps. Preserve recovered Float32 period bits and operation order rather than substitute generic Double BPM math. Trace audio-event timeline/source coordinates, AudioCluster segments and media resolution before creating playable clips. Keep unresolved media explicit. Extend via a new interpretation profile when semantics change; frozen v1 and released v2 reports must continue replaying their own baseline. Defer conflicting signature precedence until the native compatibility context is bound. Continue actual application integration with independent controls and GUI checks; no target execution.
next_priorities.historical_compatibility: Freeze schema2/cpr-static-subset-v2 historical replay; add a new profile for map recovery. Retain native fixed-clock-v1 unchanged.

next_priorities.question: What exact event, tick, ordering and state contracts connect MIDI storage/editing to musical scheduling?
next_priorities.action: Trace focused native event/tempo consumers and any independently verified serialized examples. Separate UI display ticks, preset constants and MIDI file PPQ from internal time representation. Extend the application toward MIDI data/editing/scheduling with explicit unknowns; do not infer ramp arithmetic or note semantics from names.

next_priorities.question: How are buses, sends, inserts, processing order, delay compensation and transport changes represented and scheduled?
next_priorities.action: Follow concrete routing and latency consumers and object ownership; derive discriminating impulse/route-change probes. Build mixer graph and continuous playback behavior as separate tested application slices. Existing stereo buffer preparation is not a complete mix engine.

next_priorities.question: Which host lifecycle, bus negotiation, sample-accurate parameter, state and latency contracts are required for supported VST plug-ins?
next_priorities.action: Use pinned primary SDK contracts plus bounded native host traces. Validate a self-authored calibration plug-in before external plug-in integration. Keep native host behavior, API requirements and application choices distinct; no target execution is authorized by this step.

next_priorities.question: Which native mode IDs and recorder transitions implement Touch, AutoLatch, Overwrite, trim and return behavior?
next_priorities.action: Bind recorder slots, external time/scalar units and named mode consumers before asserting a target-derived writer. Retain read-automation functionality while implementing only independently supported write-state contracts.

next_priorities.question: Do actual reference exports, imports and compound editing histories agree with the reconstructed contracts?
next_priorities.action: Resolve native writer field binding, host units and parameter conversions with bounded traces now. Keep missing-interpolation and unsupported-content checks explicit. Prepare reference differential cases for later authorization; never turn local roundtrips or schema validity into Cubase interoperability.
